scope: First native-selected own Elementary meeting page, using existing approved read commands only
output: At most four terminal technical warning identifiers from uuAppErrorMap keys; no full key prefix, messages, parameters, map values or source content
identifierValidation: Final path segment, 3..64 ASCII letters only; reject names containing token, secret, password, authorization, cookie, accesscode, bearer or credential, case-insensitive
activation: No export before explicit human approval; pilot-only flag; no caller URL or command; at most one eligible failure per pilot invocation
removal: Remove terminal-name export from the production correction once the warning is identified; no changes to Aida access or the read allowlist
